description: Despite a shaky global backdrop, from the Iran war to interest rate worries, Indian homebuyers haven't backed off, according to the Anarock Consumer Sentiment Survey – H1 2026.. Nearly 8,320 respondents across 14 cities took part in this survey, and the headline finding is a paradox: buyers are more price-conscious than ever, yet they want bigger, better homes than before. Industry executives believe a tiered structure can promote competition among insurers of different sizes.
